nom: Clarins Beauty Flash Balm Mask, Primer, Radiance Booster

avis.texte: I give this to everyone! It's fantastic I can't say enough. I use it all the time

This was the very first Clarins product I ever used, and it had such a dramatic effect on my then-youthful face that I became a lifetime customer of all things Clarins. I still love this product. I mainly use it while traveling; it is fantastic to put on during or after a long flight. It will immediately brighten and moisturize my face and improve my looks. The beauty balm truly makes me more beautiful. If you can only afford one product from Clarins, I would buy this one.

I've been a fan of Beauty Flash Balm for years for giving me an instant tightened, refreshed face. I tried this as a sample the last time I reordered the balm. I immediately noticed that my skin was more glowing and smoother. The next day I went to work, and one of my colleagues commented that I looked younger. I can't imagine a higher recommendation than this. I bought a tube for myself and one as a special gift for a friend. This might be my new secret weapon!
I love this product it makes me glow I use it everyday clarins product it's a must so gentle on my skin
I love how this makes my skin feel and the glow it gives me. My sister has raved about this product for years!

I received a sample of this in a travel kit and wore it every single day of my trip, both alone and under foundation. I loved it so much that I had to re-up when I got home. While I am not a daily makeup wearer, I have had good results wearing this product alone as a balm/deep moisturizer and under makeup as a primer. I think it smells lovely, and the texture seems similar to many of the other Clarins products I've tried since. This was the first Clarins product I've used and I'm never going to use anything else for a primer. Thank you!
I love love love this product! You can see it start working as soon as you put it on. The next morning your skin looks so nice, smooth, and glowy!
I use this product as a primer underneath my makeup. I love the texture and the smell.
This is ok, but not fantastic. I like a lot of other Clarins products better.

It is not the same as it used to be!!!!!! It was more like a cream with an awesome scent. Now, it's more a a gel-cream that smells like baby diaper cream or something. So disappointed. It was my favorite but now I don't think I'll reorder.

I started using this a few years ago after I received a sample - all I can say is now it's one product I can't live without! It's lightweght, absorbs quickly, and skin feels great. I use it alone and blended with a little foundation for a less mask like coverage

avis.titre: Easy to apply at home peel!
avis.texte: Great at home peel for maintenance between professional peels. Easy to apply with built in brush. You can feel the product working. Pairs well with Clarins overnight moisturizers.

I used to love this product but have been using other products and forgot about this. I was looking forward to the fresh, familiar smell when I bought this and was disappointed to find it has been totally reformulated and has a synthetic fragrance and don't like the texture of the new cream. Will not be buying this again.
I have bought this product three times. I find it works great with the Beauty flash exfoliator and helps my make-up stay good looking for the whole day.
I have bought this product twice. Leaves my skin glowing and refreshed. Works better than any skin peel I have had in a salon.

avis.titre: Instant Glow in Minutes – My Go-To At-Home Peel
avis.texte: This product is honestly amazing! It gives you that at-home facial glow without the hassle. One of my favorite things is that you don't even have to wash it off—just apply, let it dry, and you're good to go. The results are almost instant—your skin looks smoother, brighter, and refreshed right away. It's perfect for when you want a quick glow-up without spending hours on skincare. One con: the smell is a bit chemical-like, which might not be everyone's favorite—but the results definitely make up for it!

avis.titre: Hard to judge from a small size
avis.texte: I only tried the mini, which didn't give me enough uses to see any real results. Might be worth investing in the full size to actually evaluate it properly.
Very soothing for my dry, sensitive skin. Great as a mask, while soaking in bathtub.
Good results but not one of my favourites. I don't really understand the peel description and the fact that the product stays on the skin. I kind of hoped for a peel that I can remove

I remember a similar product years ago when I first started using CLARINS and was delighted to find this new peel recently. So easy to apply, no sticky mess, the built in brush is great. I love the cool feel of the gel on the skin and have noticed a difference in my skin since using twice a week. Skin looks clear, pores reduce and a real fresh, radiant look to the face. Will buy again.

I think I've reviewed this product before. I've been using it for more than 20 years and love it. If I use it before applying foundation, the makeup goes on more smoothly and looks better. If I'm not going out, I use it alone and it makes my skin smoother and brighter. I hope Clarins never discontinues it.
Love the way this feels. Skin feels better than it has using Mary Kay.

My husband had a sample size in one of his international flight kits, and I really like the texture and scent so I had to order. It's very lightweight but seems to moisturize very well. I do not break out. It does not affect my rosacea. Not sure I'm getting a lot of tightening yet but we will see.
It leaves my skin looking wonderful. It was a little irritating the first time I used it, but that didn't last long.
This balm wakes up my face… & serves as a great primer for when I use foundation.

avis.titre: Product was all air no product!
avis.texte: I genuinely love the formula of this product, but the travel size was a complete letdown. I bought the smaller version for a trip, only to find the bottle was filled with pressurized air and zero actual product. It's incredibly frustrating to reach for a staple item while traveling and find it empty. 5 stars for the formula, but absolutely 0 stars for quality control!
I love the beauty flash balm. It gives me a snotty finish on my make-up.

I started using Beauty Flash Balm when received as a sample. I like it when I already have make-up on and I just need a bit more moisturizer to my skin. It goes over the make-up smoothly especially in my under eye area and around my mouth. Then I just refresh my make-up over it. This is a product that will always be in my drawer.

Had to get a consultation with the specialist regarding the black spots around the nose. She suggested Beauty Flash exfoliator. I've got a sample and it worked. Ended up ordering the full-size product.

I like the product, longtime fan, but I have a real issue with the fact that the new tube that was supposed to have 0.5 oz, is underfilled compared to the labeled quantity. Has anyone else exprerienced this? I can press the tube completely with two fingers and no product comes out. With some effort I managed to squeeze out some. This is stealing.
I love this product--- it is great for everyday as a primer or on its own
Amazing, super gentle peeling, gentle on your skin and it works great, I was using it 3 times a week and my skin change a lot it's super smooth. You definitely should try it

avis.titre: Long time user of this product
avis.texte: I've been using Beauty Flash Balm for 20 years and I would highly recommend it, especially in the cooler months. It absorbs well and adds a nice glow. I use it daily as a primer, and sometimes at night as a mask, especially when I've reached the end of the tube.

I bought this product years ago and I just bought it again. It's an excellent product. It makes my skin soft moisturized gives it an even tone complexion and smooth my entire skin and I glow it's never made my Facebook look better. In fact I'm thinking of wearing this daily. It makes my face look so good.
Great product, a classic. I like using this when my skin needs a boost.
A wonderful top-off to my moisturizer! I'm also using it as a makeup primer and love it!

Soft texture gel like balm applies smoothly and effortlessly onto to skin. It brings firming tone appearance as well as brightness. I personally enjoy it as a primer under light makeup. I truly enjoy how glowing my 56yr old complexion looks and feels.
Ive been using this for a year and its my go to when wanting to get a radiant refreshed smooth look.
A must have in your moisturizing regime - right before you put on your make - get a glow up

Love this item, and again it's a bit different. It's has a sort of rubbery finish and when moisturiser is added on top of it, the finish is not very good. But, I use it on the days when I really need my complexion to look fresh. Please stop messing with a good product to only end up with a mess. Thank you, but I am being honest.

This is my favorite Clarins product. Very happy with results. I would have another favorite product if Clarins ever revives and starts to re-distribute. Eclat Minute brush on Perfector. I miss that very much!
Works great. I use this every morning and feel a noticeable difference.

avis.titre: Does what it says it will.
avis.texte: This product is a very good exfoliant. Very easy to apply with the built-in brush. Skin looks refined after using. I would buy again.

I've used this before and still have the old formula. Received this sample and used it to do my makeup on my birthday. The foundation applied on top of the Beauty Flash Balm really did not look good. My mores were accentuated and foundation was very visible on my Tzone. It also slightly pilled. I did not like the gel like formula. So sad to see a great product gone because the "reformulation" is something totally not like it or not better. It is different and performance is worse.

Beauty Flash balm was my FAVORITE makeup product. For years. People would even ask me what product I was using that my skin looked so good. Apparently it was changed. It's horrible now. Makes the pores on my skin look obvious and there is no tightening effect anymore. Please change it back and if you do, let me know.
This is a must for your beauty routine as it leaves one's skin incredibly soft.

This is an excellent product. I've been using it since my late 30's and am now in my mid 70's. It's most useful in the morning when I go to the gym and just need something to get my skin going before my usual skin regimen after the gym.
I have been using this for thirty years but I'm not so keen on the new texture and color . I much prefer the old BFB .

This balm is amazing!! It made my skin not only look and feel tight and moisturized, but it kept my makeup in place outside in 102 degree weather!! It's amazing!! I got home and immediately ordered a full size! I previously only had a sample of it.
Absolutely love the dewy texture that this product gives my skin. Perfect for applying before makeup so it never looks splotchy or dry in certain areas. Scent is nice as well.

avis.titre: Great looking skin with first try
avis.texte: I have never used a product that gives such overall wonderful results. It addressed, smooth skin, lighten dark spots, minimize pores. This morning there was a very light flake of old skin, no redness or irritation, just a smooth and beautiful result. I have used many of Clarins product, and with some exceptions liked them all. But this one is off the charts winner.

I didn't use this kind of acids before, but I have a combination type of skin and my pores get congested pretty fast. It was time to try. This product smooths the surface of the skin, gives a nice deep cleans, and fresh look and glow on the face after use.
I've been using this product for many years, and it works perfectly. I use it before special occasions, and my face looks like new.

avis.titre: Brightness your skin in a flash
avis.texte: This product truly Brightness your skin in a flash. I love it.

avis.titre: Not as it used to be
avis.texte: Not like it used to be. Color, odor, and coverage not as good as it used to be

After reading so many negative comments about the new version of Beauty Flash Balm, I still decided to try a sample and was completely disappointed just like all its former loyal customers. I had been buying this balm for many years - it was my favorite face cream. I am glad that I still have a tube with the old version in the fridge. But no purchasing it in future. The gel texture, the smell are very unpleasant and do nothing to my skin in comparison with the beautiful results of using the previous version. A Clarins representative recommended here to replace the balm with SOS primer. I bought it and it does not even come close to the former Beauty Flash Balm. I still cannot believe that Clarins can do such things to its reputation.

avis.titre: Bring back the 'OLD' Beauty Flash Balm!
avis.texte: I am so disappointed with this 'newly imagined' Beauty Flash Balm. It was awful. Instead of protecting my skin and keeping the makeup intanct, this 'NEW' Flash Balm absolved my foundation that in a few hours I looked worse than no-makeup face. I've been using Clarins since my young adulthood. Among my cherished product was the 'OLD' Beauty Flash Balm. So, thinking that I must have applied wrongly, I've tried several times more, using less skincare products and waited before applying this 'newly imagined' Flash Balm in different days. The results were the same leaving my face with awful looking skin. I don't understand why Clarins destroyed a perfectly good product. I implore you to please 'BRING THE OLD FORMULA BACK!'.

avis.titre: This is not Beauty Flash Balm
avis.texte: Zero stars is more fitting. Like so many others, I have used Clarins for decades. The old Beauty Flash Balm was one of my favorite products, one that I kept with me at all times. If my skin felt dry or dull at any point throughout the day, I'd pat that on and it was like it revived me. This new formula should not have the same name. Clarins, if you HAVE to change formulas - especially so drastically, at least have the decency to rename the product. I never would have bought this again had I known it was NOTHING like the one I've used for so many years. The color, the smell, the consistency, the texture, the result…completely different. I feel like anyone who left a good review can't possibly have used the old formula, and don't know what they're missing!
Does anyone elses skin burn when they use this product? I leave it on for 5 minutes and during that time it burns/irritates my skin.
Love it! My skin feels so hydrated when I use it and I love the light fragrance!!!

After using the exfoliator, all my friends were curious to know who the lucky guy was. My partner asked if I had found new love, the answer was ABSOLUTELY…I am amazed at the results. My skin is as vibrant, clear and youthful as a spring chick. This is the best new skincare product I have discovered in years.
I really do not care for the "new and improved" balm. The older version was so much better in terms of providing coverage. It was light but creamy and very moisturizing.
Such an extraordinary quick effect-I use it before online meetings to get natural radiance seen in the screen
This is the best peel I have ever used. My skin became so soft and shiny. Thanks Clarins, I will recommend this product to my friends because it really works.
Awful. Nothing like the old trusty formula. This new sticky gel smells synthetic and feels greasy. Why did they choose to ruin an amazing product?!
This product is one of the best. It leaves your skin looking fresh and dewy. I apply before primer. If you went makeup free, I would use this
I cannot live without the Beauty Flash Balm. You can feel it tightening as soon as you put it on!
It just is not the same as the old formula. Please bring it back.
Love it! My skin looks great and feels great…and I am almost 68!
I am 66 years old and I've been using Clarence since I was 30 years old. I use beauty flash balm for over 20 years. Please change the formula back to the old one. It was much better.

avis.titre: Beauty Flash Balm is not what it use to be.
avis.texte: This is a product that I purchase because I loved how it brightens, however this time the product seems different and does do nothing for me.
I love this product and use it twice each week. It makes my face feel smoother and more even. At 54 years old, that is fabulous as most products do not deliver this type of texture after use.

avis.titre: On my journey to clear skin
avis.texte: It's helping my acne. It's been years since my skin has been acne prone..I'm hoping that this will help tremendously.
Good product for exfoliation without all the irritation! Very easy to use.
Love the instant skin tightening with this product! The name matches the result!

I have been a user of Beauty Flash for over 40 years. It is the one product I have purchased over and over again. I loved the texture, how it brightened my skin. I often received compliments on how glowing my skin appeared. All due to the original Beauty Flash. Alas, this is no longer the case. The new formula is ordinary, not as moisturizing and I am not seeing the glow that used to be prior to your reformulation. I am very, very disappointed and dismayed that such a successful and great product would be changed. And not for the better.

so I got this randomly from my stepmom and it's okay, i didn't ever get to try the old one but the old one seems a lot better according to the 1 star reviews. I hate the gel-like consistency and orange color, it just always looks and feels like it went bad. it also smells very strongly of old grandma perfume and I don't want that on my face. I gave it 3 stars because it does feel thick, rich, and hydrating on your face, so there's that. this has a lot of room for improvement; come on clarins. overall it's okay and dont use often. if someone is reading this, I do recommend the clarins night cream, I really liked that.

Clarins Beauty Flash Balm is a hidden gem of a product because it's multi functional. It can be used as a quick 10 minute mask. It moisturizes but also adds a subtle glow to my skin. I like using it as a primer under my mineral powder foundation.

This peel is absolutely a game changer for my skin: I am 40 with a sensitive skin with pigmentation, prone to scars. Using it for a month now I am very delighted with the results: my skin has smoother complexion and look brighter. I am using it twice a week overnight.

avis.titre: It is not the same as...
avis.texte: It is not the same as before. Please change the formula back. The old version was more hydrated and boosting.
So far I can tell my pores are smaller. Ready to see more change.
I use this product since 25 years! It is my favorite mask and refreshes my face almost like a lifting! Over my foundation or after work while I do a nap!

avis.titre: A beauty balm for the win
avis.texte: My mom bought me this one year as a gift and told me i'd love it, she wasnt wrong. I use this on top of my face oil/sunscreen and it gives your skin a great healthy glow, improves texture and gives me the confidence to go out sans makeup (no foundation/powder)

avis.titre: Best peel, feeling my skin smooth and soft
avis.texte: I will continue to use for the later weeks hoping my blackheads disappear
It was perfect before. Why did you change it? It doesn't work on my face or blend well with my makeup. Utterly disappointed.

avis.titre: Get radiant, well rested & vibrant skin over night
avis.texte: After cleansing with Clarins Mineral Water, I apply a small amount each night. The Peel leaves my skin looking radiant, vibrant, and well rested the following morning. I love the glow that it gives me; however, I do think it can be improved. The instructions says to "not wash off." The next morning, white flakes will be all over your face. I don't know if the flaking is dead skin cells or simply dried peel, but I do wonder if it has flaked off (invisibly) onto my bed and/or pillowcase. For this reason, I gave a rting of 4 instead of 5.
I love this balm! It's not thick, blends easily, and makes my skin feel smooth.

I love this flash balm. I use it before I apply foundation. It really smooths and hydrates all day. Once whil traveling I forgot my moisturizer. I used the flash blam and it was a freat substitute for a couple of days- Beauty Balm saved the day!

I live in the high desert and struggle to maintain moisture on my skin. I tried the beauty flash balm as a sample and couldn't wait to receive my full size product. Using Beauty Flash Balm my face feels moisturized all day.

Easy application for this product, I have used this twice now, I did notice a slight glow. So it might be to early to tell if it is going to do anything special for me. I do have several skin issues that I am looking for ways to help correct. Fingers crossed that this product will help out with my hyperpigmentation, uneven skin tone and texture. (hormones)

avis.titre: It is work rights . But I will like more bigger.
avis.texte: This was to small for the price I pay. I will like Clarins send me one more bigger.

I love this peel. My skin is smoother and my large pores are practically non-existent after use. I use a couple of times a week. I was amazed at how quickly I saw results. This will definitely be part of my beauty routine from now on.

Visibly more beautiful skin the day after the night I use it. I tried it on my husband and it didn't seem to help him much, but maybe his skin is so far gone, he needs to improve it a bit more first. (Bought him the Clarins mens line to start him on his product journey - at 52 years old for him.)
This really has made a difference to my skins appearance and feel. Highly recommend!
I decided to try this based on what the product description - I'm so glad I did, great moisturizer and primer

First tried this as a sample from an Air France amenity bag. Loved the feel of the balm and liked how it brightened my skin as I don't wear anything but moisturizer on my face. I do think the samples I tried were a slightly different formulation than the version now being sold, but I still like it.

New one is just terrible and does not deserve to be called by the same name!!!! Does Not do what the old one did dispute its claim s I used the Old Flash Balm for over 20 years would wake up a tired face in a sec over makeup under the eye! This one is horrible I ck back every so often to c if perhaps by some chance they get smart and brought back the old formula but I'm still disappointed Everyone that used the Old formula Totally Understands what a loss and bummer this really is ~ if the old one isn't returning Plz change the name on the new one~ u have dishonored a wonderful product !

Clarins: I'm begging you. Make a fragrance-free version of Beauty Flash Balm. It's a fantastic product and I can't use it without being nauseated and getting a migraine. The fragrance adds nothing. People can wear perfume if they want to, but it's just not necessary in a face cream.
Amazing Baum! There is nothing like it. Very creamy and moisturizing

avis.titre: Great addition to my nighttime routine!
avis.texte: The product applicator is easy to use. My skin felt lovely the next morning!
It's so disappointing when great products are discontinued. The old formula was perfect, expensive but worth it. Too bad they changed it.
this is a chemical peel… not the balm. The two are very different. This should not be worn under makeup. Product is nice & leaves my skin barrier smooth.
Do not like the new formula! Why change something that's working?

I've been using Beauty Flash Balm for many years, under makeup and on it's own. Loved the texture, light pleasant fragrance and how it made my skin feel. Now, it's more of a gel than a cream with an odd, chemical smell. I stopped using my favorite Clarins toner for similar reasons and now I'll stop using this. Why do you keep changing - degrading - wonderful products?
It's great for traveling. I keep it in my purse and use it whenever I need a little face pick me up!

I never start the day without including Flash Balm on my morning routine. I've been using it for well over 40 years. My skin always feels fresh and if Im wearing makeup it stays fresh for the entire day.

avis.titre: Flash Beauty for Real! NO make-up needed!
avis.texte: I love this product. It is one of my favorite Clarins. It is a great "make-up", it is really lives up to the name: makes your skin beautiful in a flash!
not for sensitive skin AT ALL. I had a horrible allergic reaction after using this product! Woke up with my eyes swollen shut. Dont even waste your money on this.
I love this product. It is so easy to apply. I love that you don't have to rinse it off. My skin feels so clean afterwards.

avis.titre: Miss the original Beauty Flash Balm
avis.texte: I agree with other reviewers - the new formulation doesn't work nearly as well. It's a different consistency and coverage. It doesn't offer the same benefits that the original did in coverage and allowing my make up to be smooth on my skin.
Loved everything about the old version of the Beauty Flash Balm. Texture. Smell. Absorption. All were wonderful. This new formula is very different from the old. Can we go back?
Makes my skin moist without feeling greasy. Lovely smell. Not sure it eliminates all my fine lines but it does have a slight blurring affect.
A wonderful product! Makes your face feel cool and clean. And makes it look its best with that needed "lift."

avis.titre: Not the same than the first formula
avis.texte: I got a sample with the first formula and when I decided to buy it they changed it
Longtime customer since the eighties. I feel this is one of Clarins' best products.

avis.titre: Does what it says for face
avis.texte: Have purchased this beauty flash balm severs times and found it does plumb and refresh your facial skin esp lines and creases. Wonderful product!

avis.titre: Comfortable  cream gel with a boost
avis.texte: Formula seems to have slightly changed (more gel than cream). Love the lightly tinted texture . The boost effect is real, perfect for weekend skin routine
I love the new formula. The texture and scent are lovely. I will definitely add to my routine. Thank you Clarins!
I don't notice any tightening or anything at all. Won't buy again.

I have been so impressed with this product. It's a staple for me, and I use it almost everyday to help quickly restore the color back to my face. When I'm tired, dehydrated and my dark circles are in full force, this beauty balm helps bring me back to life. It's very hydrating too, and lasts all day. Highly Recommend!
This product made my skin look like I just gotten an expensive facial!! You only need to leave the product on for 5-10 minutes and then you get an instant glow to the face. 10/10!
I have been receiving these products and I have loved them, I invite you to try them, they are cheap, quite accessible and good quality
Leaves u a new skin literally. Smell good and the product is super easy to apply. Really good one. You have to be careful with this but is really good.

this was my first time trying this product and they were small bottles but they did give me 2 so that was a plus this product was very worth it my skin feels cleaner softer and looks better after the first week I love that it doesn't need any improvement I recommend and would buy again.

My skin felt really nice and smooth after using this product. However I did have a little bit of dryness. It is also hard for me to give a fulll review as I would need to use this multiple times to see the true effects.

avis.titre: Sadly didn't come with the brush
avis.texte: I wish I knew what kind of brush it came with and could have tested it with the product to know how well they work together. I did like this, but the instructions were confusing. I was unsure if I was supposed to leave it on or rinse off so I decided to rinse off. I did like how it made my skin feel afterwards. My skin felt firmer and brighter.
Made my skin look like glass after I am definitely going to but the bigger size and put this in my skincare routine. Holy grail
The gel is sticky but goes on smooth. It made my face tingle a bit. I didn't really notice much difference in my skins appearance before or after
Personally I am in love with this product. At the beginning I was scary maybe I could get burned since my skin is really sensitive but I tried and I loved it! My skin looks amazing and more even.
I feel like it didn't do much for my skin. I think it may have gave me a little reaction. I just didn't care for this product like I thought I would
Really good peel product. Not too harsh on my skin and makes my skin look and feel healthier and much better. Works great

This reminds me of the ordinary BHA peel which is cheaper but this seems to be slightly less harsh. I think it's definitely anything good to keep in your skincare routine when you're skin is feeling rough or dull

avis.titre: Nice Peel! Noticed a difference in 3 days!
avis.texte: This was a very nice facial peel! within 3 days, i could see it starting to work. especially around the lower half of my face and chin. it gave me a more hydrated and smoothed look. i would recommend. it did my my chin particularly "flaky" for a few days. but the results were worth it!

I'm not usually one to go to a spa and get a facial. This product lets you experience the benefits right at home. It's a peel that takes about 10 minutes, and leaves skin feeling tighter and radiant. I feel like my skin texture improved after using it just once.
I liked the light gel texture of this chemical exfoliant. I'm already familiar with the Clarins brand, and this is definitely good quality. My skin felt lretty smooth afterwards, and it felt gentle.
i truly do love this product, my skin is definitely combo between dry and oily, and whenever i use this is makes me skin look so nice :)

I actually really loved this product it left my skins feeling smooth and looking glowy after just using it one time! I would imagine after continuous use it would be a great addition to a skin care routine.

Wonderful Clarins Beauty Flash Peel left my face with a great refreshing boost , feels like I'm using a product from the spa and the results are fantastic.My skin tone looks great and feels great after this treatment . Can't wait to buy more.

avis.titre: Please don't discontinue this product ever!!!
avis.texte: Can't be without it! Does everything it claims to do! You will be happy with the results !

I've Been using this product since 2011…. It was perfect. But now you changed it and it's not the same quality!!! Runny gel like consistency. Doesn't have the same skin tightening , glow and rested effect on the skin. Very disappointed! Will not buy again.
I am loving this product. It leaves my face feeling moisturized and firm!
Nice texture and very smooth on the skin. Hoping for long term results.

avis.titre: No the same as the old formula sorry
avis.texte: I have been using clarins since i was 20, i am 42 now. always used this product is was excellent, now the new one ☝️ is a no no 😭 no the same at all! the smell the texture everything is totally different, I wish I could return it. never will buy again. I have to find myself a new one.

Immediately yes. I adore this as the step before foundation (or skin tint) but with no waiting time. You have to apply then and then it's go time unless you are using as a mask. It smoothes and firms it a subtle but noticeable way, allowing you to fake the effects of masking etc in a pinch. Love this when I'm in a rush or between events changing make up.

avis.titre: Why mess with success? Bring back the old formula
avis.texte: The original balm was the gold standard that I have loved for decades. Why change it with an awful new formulation? It has a tacky feel, weird scent and is nothing like the original. Clarins, please if you want to introduce a newly formulated product name it something else and leave the original beauty flash balm alone!

Having been a longtime (many years) user of Beauty Flash, I purchased more to replenish. Much to my disappointment, the formula has changed significantly. The perfect finish of the old formula has been replaced by something slightly sticky without the perfecting benefits. Please bring back the old formula! (And please bring back tinted sunscreen! This is another product I have used for years, recommended to dozens of people and it has been unavailable for months. What is going on at my favorite beauty "go to" Clarins???)

I came here to buy a new flash beauty balm only to learn that it's been reformulated into something that people say bears little resemblance to the original and that no one - including MUAs - seems to like. Oooph. This was a holy grail product for me and I'm leaving the site empty handed. Please bring back the original 5-star product!
Very hydrating and glowy. Refreshing for a mid day pick me up.

I am a makeup artist and for the last 45 years, Beauty Flash has been the #1 product in my kit, hands down. Makeup goes on smoothly, does not move for hours and hours and the youthful glow that comes through is better than any "glow" product out there. I have recommended it, globally, thousands of times, with every client absolutely loving it ….. until now. Beauty flash worked, year in and year out, why now, have you messed with it? I can't recommend this gem anymore. Please please please bring back the old formula!!!

avis.titre: My skin loves the beauty balms!
avis.texte: I love the beauty flash balm products. They perk me up and my skin loves them. I've been using the balms for 30 years. I must tell you, people think I'm in my 50's but I just turned 70. They are shocked. If only they knew my secret. Please don't stop bringing such great products to market.

avis.titre: Please restore the original Beauty Flash Balm
avis.texte: I don't understand why Clarins changed the formula. The original formula was perfect for the purpose. The new one made my makeup stuck to the skin, and later absorbed the makeup that my face looked haggard by late afternoon. I had to retouch the foundation but the underlying rather sticky balm make the makeup look thick and splotched. I stop buying this new Flash Balm and am hoping that Clarins will come back to its senses and restore the original Flash Balm.

avis.titre: TERRIBLE REFORMULATION OF A PERFECT PRODUCT
avis.texte: Like so many others, I used the original Beauty Flash Balm for many years and absolutely loved it! It made my skin look and feel fabulous and was so silky and smooth to apply. Also loved it for a quick skin refresh at the end of my work day if I was going out. I purchased the new formula a number of months ago, and really hated it. It was so sticky on my skin, and I could not apply makeup over it for the stickiness. My skin did not feel at all smooth, plumped, or revitalized as it always had with the original formula. It also had a very odd and not pleasing fragrance. Thankfully, at the time, I found a holiday gift set that included the original formula, so I bought about 6 sets, just to have the original BFB product. I have used up all but one, so now I really don't know what to do. PLEASE, PLEASE, PLEASE BRING BACK THE ORIGINAL FORMULA - OR MAKE BOTH AVAILABLE. I am seeing as many people in these reviews who do not like the new formula as those who do, so that could be a good option. Please listen to us and bring back the original and wonderful BFB. This, to me, is a classic example of breaking something that clearly was not broken.
It is definitely a good product. It helps the make up look better.
This product does a good job of setting my makeup so it stays fresh looking.

avis.titre: Not a pleasant to use as the original
avis.texte: The scent is not pleasing, but I think the product still works. I also preferred the prior texture.

avis.titre: Works well to smooth the skin!!
avis.texte: I use this after toning and serum to lift and tighten the skin before applying makeup. A lot goes a long way and the texture is easy to work with!

Disappointed. I can't get past the unpleasant scent, so I won't use it. I can live without it, but it makes me sad. The original product was ideal and had an elegant scent and texture. This change reminds me of the great fail years ago when Coca Cola changed its winning formula. For a while both versions were offered, calling the "old" version Coke Classic. Eventually they went back to offering just the original. Could you possibly offer the old Beauty Flash Balm as well as the new, somewhat unpopular, one? BFB Classic? BFB Old School? I'm sure you want to continue to delight happy loyal guests.
Haven't used it enough to see if it works. Goes on smoothly and not greasy

I bought the new and improve Beauty Flash Balm a few months ago and was extremely disappointed. I loved, loved, loved the original product. It was a staple in my skincare routine. Anytime I needed a booster to my face, I would put it on. I did wonders for me. Please bring back the original formula because this new formula is not worth a dime.
Why even call it the same name? It is NOTHING LIKE THE ORIGINAL! Terrible smell, inconsistent, jelly-like formula. No thank you.

As always, Clarins create something that no one has. I always feared peelings, but this one is super gentle. Works even for my sensitive skin. Great wow effect on next morning! This is a love from first sight!
I used this product for years and loved it. I tried to new formula and its rank! Smells bad, terrible texture. I have no idea what this is supposed to do.
A little goes a long way! I use daily, even if not applying makeup.

avis.titre: Go back to the old formula!
avis.texte: I bought the. full size after getting sample sizes in recent purchases. I loved the smell and the silky feel the original left on my skin. I knew something was wrong when I opened the new tube and it was orange and not white. The smell is almost off putting, and not the lovely fresh scent of the original. I'm not seeing any better results over the old formula either. Sorry Clarins, but "If it ain't broke, don't fix it.". I will not be buying this again.

I've been using beauty flash balm for 20 years…and have loved it….but with my recent purchase discovered a new formulation….and it is no longer the same product. So DISAPPOINTED and won't be purchasing again. Also very unhappy that this was not clearly labeled on the packaging as I bought three tubes.

I can't understand the negative reviews. I was absolutely blown away by the finish this gave my skin as used as the last step I. My skincare before I applied my makeup. It was so smooth and my skin looked almost poreless and very little texture. My fine lines were even gone. I will definitely be repurchasing this. Make sure you don't over apply it.

I have been using the Beauty baum for years. My daughter surprised me with 2 new tubes for my birthday. It has a red cap, so I thought maybe repackaged. NO its a completely different product! It used to be smooth, clean feeling, freshening and tight tingling on my face before applying make up. NOW the new product is greasy, jelly like, and smells weird. I could just cry that Clarins is not making the Beauty Baum Bright and Tighten, with a white, any longer. I am hoping to find some at a cosmetic counter that may have some from 2022. I had a tube, unopened, in a piece of luggage I found from 4 years ago and its gonna have to last me till I can find more. Why did Clarins have to reinvent this wheel, it WAS a great product.
Everytime I use this I think, I love this stuff! I do not know what it does exactly, all I know is my skin looks better when I use it and my makeup lasts longer.
I have used Flash Balm for almost 10 years and love the way it feels. This new product is nothing like the original…call it what it is… sticky, gel. I plan to return this.
I've used Clarins faithfully for almost 40 years. BFB was an absolute favorite in all that time - this new formula is not nearly as good as its predecessor. Please bring it back.

Please bring back the old formula. This new reformulation is terrible!!! It's absolutely nothing like the original and it doesn't work anymore. Why did you reformulate it to supposedly say to make it better, but it's not actually better it's now terrible?!! It's cheapened and it's sticky and it peels and it doesn't work like the original. The original was a masterpiece of a product and now you have destroyed it and cheapened it. I thought your products were of high quality? Well, this is not it shaking my head with such dissapointment. Please bring back the wild formula.
Why did you take such a wonderful great product that was amazing and reformulated to such a horrible cheapened product?!!! Bring back the original formula!! This new version is terrible.
Love it! This product is the real deal. My skin is literally glowing! I use only once a week and the peeling is almost immediate.
Absolutely loved how this left my face feeling extremely clean and smooth. I had no allergic reactions and it's perfect for sensitive skin. I will be purchasing this when my sample runs out!
I am very disappointed with the new beauty flash balm. Not liking the texture or smell of the cream….PLEASE BRING BACK THE OLD ONE ……
My skin looks so fresh without a heavy moisturizer. And my makeup stays on well too.
The tightening feature of the product was not as strong as I had expected.

This new formula is awful. I am so thankful I was able to try a sample size before wasting money a large tube. It is horrible, there is no other way to describe it. You have taken a beautiful product, cheapened it and expected this would be an acceptable reformulation? This is nothing like the original and it's definitely not an improvement. This product was a classic and was perfect the way it was, there was no need to change it. Please bring back the old formula. This is not an acceptable substitute and as I already said, it's certainly not an improvement. Please send this feedback to the proper department and request they bring back the old formula. And before you reply about a consult, like you have on other negative reviews, I am an esthetician, I know what works for my skin. As they say, this ain't it!

I've been using glycolic acid off and on for nearly 30 years and BY FAR this is the best glycolic I've ever used. It exfoliates all the dead skin off and leaves your face smooth and glowing. My makeup has never gone on so well. I will be using this for many years to come
Absolutely loved how this left my face feeling extremely clean and smooth. I had no allergic reactions and it's perfect for sensitive skin
